content: Matamu ghahenu
Bhela kwa ndandi Kristo akang'ahakiki muhyegha jake, na mwanganya nanamu mbya na liholalelu lelele ngati jombi, maghambu jombi joang'ahakike muhyegha alekini na mahoku.
Kutumbu sajeno matamu ghaghahighali kutama pani pundema impalika kutama ngati moapali Chapanga, wala nga kwa matokulelu ghinu mahakau gha kimundu.

Maghambu pamwande mkabhi na chikahi chilachu cha kuhenga mambu ghabhahenga bhandu bhangakummanya Chapanga. Mkatami kwa kuhenga ukemi, matokulelu mahakau, kulobhela uwembi, uwangalalu wa kulobhela uwembi nakanope, na kulobhela na kuhenga mambu mahakau, na kujojabhela imong'umong'u.
Sajenu, bhandu bhangakummanya Chapanga habha bhunkangacha pabhabhona kubha ngachendombana nabhu kabhete mu kuhenga mahakau ghaghapetali hagha, na bhela bhatenda kuntondola.
Nambu anabhapalika kumuyanga Chapanga panani ja mambu ghabhu ghabhahengike, chikahi Chapanga paabhatemu bhabhabhi bhomi na bhabhapotile.

Nde ndandi hata Malobhi Manyahi ghakatangizwi hata kwa bhandu bhala bhabhapotile, nahuli baada ja kutemuliwa mu matamu ghabhu gha kihyegha ngati bhandu bhange, bhatamaje kwa ndandi jaka Chapanga kwa indela jaka Roho Mhuhu.
Mtumika wambone wa nhupu yaka Chapanga
Ujomukelu wa mambu ghokape uheghalile, bhela, mlilingalyaje na mkeshaje kwa kundobha Chapanga.
Nakanopi ja ghanihagha ghokapi mpalanaje mabheti kwa mabheti, maghambu upalu uyekale mahoku ghamahele.
Nkalibishanaje kwa upalu mabheni kwa mabheni panga na kung'ong'uteka.
Kila jumu apalika kutumila nhupu jeapekiwi na Chapanga kwa nyonjeka ja bhandu bhange, ngati njemalela wambone wa chihomu patalipatali yaka Chapanga.

Mundu jokapi joatangaza, apalika atangaza malobhi ghaka Chapanga; joatumika apalika utumakya kwa makili ghaapekewa na Chapanga, nahuli Chapanga alumbalikaje kupetela Yesu Kristo kwa ghokapi. Ulumbalilu na uweza ubhi najombi mileli na mileli. Amina.
Kung'ahika kwa kunhobhale Kristo
Bhapalu bhangu, ngamwikangacha panani ja malengakeku makolongwa ghamughapata, kwa ndandi mambu ghaghumpata nga maghene.
Nambu mhekalyaje maghambu mkang'ahakiki ngati Kristo moakang'ahakike nahuli pawiyekuliwa ulumbalilu waki muhekalya nakanope.
Muhekalyaje ngati anabhuntondola kwa ndandi ja kunjengale Kristo, maghambu Roho wa ulumbalilu joabhi Roho waka Chapanga atama na mwehapa.
Ngati mundu jokapi anaang'ahika, ngaying'ahika kwa ndandi jombi nde mkoma bhandu, mwihi, mundu joahenga mahakau au joajingalila mambu gha bhandu bhange.
Nambu anangati mundu ang'ahika maghambu anhobhale Kristo, bhela, ngayibhona iyone, nambu andumbalya Chapanga, kwa kulowakeka kwa lihina laka Kristo.

Kwa ndandi chikahi cha utemulo chihikike na utemulu hoghu utumbu na bhandu bhaka Chapanga. Bhela anangati utemulu hoghu utumbu kwitu tepani, bho, anakubya bhole kwa bhandu bhala bhangakuhobhalela Malobhi Manyahi ghaka Chapanga?
Ngati Malembu Mahuhu moghapwaghila:

content.text: “Ngati anakunonopa kwaka mundu joahenga ngati moapali Chapanga kukengalewa,
bho, anakubya bhole kwaka mundu jwangakumtii Chapanga na mwana mahoku?”

content: Bhela bhala bhabhang'ahika ngati moapali Chapanga, bhajendalya kuhenga matendu ghambone na kulibheka bheni kwaka Jobhabhombike ambaju nde ndongwana nakanope.
